name: Intuitive
description: Intuitive (Intuitive Surgical, Inc.) is a surgical robotics company founded in 1995 and headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, USA. The company develops the multiport da Vinci line ([da Vinci](/robot/intuitive_da_vinci), [da Vinci S](/robot/intuitive_da_vinci_S), [da Vinci Si](/robot/intuitive_da_vinci_Si), [da Vinci Xi](/robot/intuitive_da_vinci_Xi), [da Vinci X](/robot/intuitive_da_vinci_X), and [da Vinci 5](/robot/intuitive_da_vinci_5)), the single-port [da Vinci SP](/robot/intuitive_da_vinci_SP), and the [Ion](/robot/intuitive_ion) endoluminal bronchoscopy system. Intuitive merged with [Computer Motion](/company/computer_motion) in 2003 and acquired the robotic endoscope manufacturing operations of [Schölly Fiberoptic](/company/schoelly_fiberoptic) in July 2019.
